scenes.label: THE DEBUGGING MOMENT
headline: Your app breaks.
What happened?
scenes.narration: When your app breaks, your logs should tell the story.
captions: When your app breaks,
当应用出现问题时，
your logs should tell the story.
日志应当还原事情的经过。

scenes.label: MEET MXLOGGER
headline: One logging core.
Three ecosystems.
scenes.narration: Meet M X Logger. Cross-platform logging for i O S, Android, and Flutter.
captions: Meet MXLogger.
认识 MXLogger。
Cross-platform logging for iOS, Android, and Flutter.
面向 iOS、Android 和 Flutter 的跨平台日志库。

scenes.label: BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE
headline: Native at the core.
Compact on disk.
scenes.narration: A native C plus plus core uses memory-mapped files and FlatBuffers to write compact logs.
captions: A native C++ core uses memory-mapped files
原生 C++ 核心采用内存映射文件，
and FlatBuffers to write compact logs.
通过 FlatBuffers 写入紧凑的日志。

scenes.label: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR LOGS
headline: Encrypt. Rotate.
Keep what matters.
scenes.narration: Encrypt log files with A E S, and control rotation, retention, and disk usage.
captions: Encrypt log files with AES.
使用 AES 加密日志文件。
And control rotation, retention, and disk usage.
并管理文件轮转、保留时间和磁盘用量。

scenes.label: MXLOGGER ANALYZER
headline: Find the signal.
Skip the noise.
scenes.narration: Import dot M X files into the analyzer. Search by keyword, level, time, name, or tag.
captions: Import .mx files into the analyzer.
将 .mx 文件导入日志分析器。
Search by keyword, level, time, name, or tag.
按关键词、级别、时间、名称或标签搜索。

scenes.label: CONTEXT MAKES THE DIFFERENCE
headline: See the details.
Understand the why.
scenes.narration: Expand structured J SON, and inspect nearby records to understand what happened.
captions: Expand structured JSON.
展开结构化 JSON 数据。
Inspect nearby records to understand what happened.
查看前后日志，理解问题发生的过程。

scenes.label: WHEREVER YOU DEBUG
headline: On your desktop.
Inside your app.
scenes.narration: Analyze on your desktop, or inspect logs right inside your Flutter app.
captions: Analyze on your desktop.
在桌面端分析日志。
Or inspect logs right inside your Flutter app.
也可直接在 Flutter 应用内查看日志。

scenes.label: START WITH A SINGLE RECORD
headline: Add MXLogger.
Capture the context.
scenes.narration: Add M X Logger to your project and start capturing useful context.
captions: Add MXLogger to your project.
将 MXLogger 集成到项目中。
And start capturing useful context.
开始记录有用的运行上下文。

Debug smarter.

MXLogger：高效记录，更好地调试。
